name: GPT-4.1
description: Upgraded GPT-4 with improved coding, instruction following, and long context.
longDescription: GPT-4.1 is the successor to GPT-4o, delivering major improvements in coding ability, instruction following, and long-context understanding. It supports a 1M token context window and achieves significantly higher scores on SWE-bench and coding evaluations.
limitations: Reasoning not as deep as o3

codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI()
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4.1",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
